ACCEPT

This question effectively targets the core challenge of identifying logical inconsistencies in sports scenarios. By focusing on specific contradiction types (rule violations, impossible sequences, physical impossibilities), it guides the model toward recognizing critical failure points in sports reasoning. The question is Socratic as it prompts deeper analysis of what makes scenarios invalid rather than just surface-level pattern matching. This approach should improve the model's ability to distinguish plausible from implausible sports situations.
